entities.summary: Chanan Safir Colman is a Danish-Israeli professional basketball player for Hapoel Haifa of the Israel Basketball Premier League. He played college basketball for Chipola before playing professionally in Finland, Israel, and Denmark. Colman was named the Finnish League Finals MVP in 2006 and the Danish League MVP in 2012.
